part_a_within_arm_same_contig_positional.eligibility_rule: Uniform random pseudo-focal gene index j on same contig where all 4 flanks (j-2, j-1, j+1, j+2) are exact-coordinate Bakta-mapped (mapped_KO or mapped_noKO)

part_b_between_arm_matched_pairs_tier1.balance_diagnostic_note: Soft caliper (|dz_opp|<=0.75, |dz_len|<=1.25, soft phylum penalty) balances species breadth (SMD=0.0661) and KO annotation opportunity (SMD=0.0297) across 148 pairs, but retains residual imbalance on sequence length (SMD=0.3622) and phylum_group (62.2% exact match) due to structural length separation between K (mean 281.6 aa) and QnotK (mean 243.8 aa). See strict_exact_phylum_caliper_sensitivity for exact-lineage + tight-length (|dz_len|<=0.50) matching.

cross_family_locus_and_species_independe.species_resampling_methodological_note: Descriptive fixed-family-outcome reweighting under species cluster resampling. Does not recompute multi-species recurrence or stratified Delta_MH.
